- x0 = ofcolor(I, 2) - red cells indices

- x2 = dmirror if hline else identity
- x3 = x2(I) - if red is horizontal, transpose (so red becomes vertical)
- x4 = fgpartition(x3) - objects (non-background)
- x6 = not color==2 → find object not red, which is the green pattern (color 3)
- x7 = the green object
- x8 = ofcolor(x3, 2) - red cells
- x9 = leftmost(x8) - leftmost column of red
- x10 = leftmost(x7) - leftmost column of green
- x11 = x9 > x10 - red is to the right of green
- x12 = manhattan(x7, x8) - closest distance
- x13 = x12 - 1
- x14 = identity if x11 else invert
- x15 = decrement if x11 else increment
- x16 = leftmost if x11 else rightmost
- x17 = x14(x13)
- x18 = tojvec(x17) = (0, x17)
- x19 = shift(x7, x18) - shift green by (0, x17)
- x20 = x16(x19) - leftmost or rightmost of shifted green
- x21 = x15(x20) - decrement or increment
- x22 = tojvec(x21) = (0, x21)
- x23 = vfrontier(x22) - vertical line at column x21 (all rows)
- x24 = cover(x3, x7) - remove green
- x25 = paint(x24, x19) - paint shifted green
- x26 = fill(x25, 8, x23) - fill blue vertical line
